nodes.label: Recurring Weekly Seed
nodes.rationale: The seed is a recurring weekly schedule projected onto every matching weekday. Tuesday evening is deliberately crammed so the chaos rebalance has raw material.

nodes.label: Dark Mode (Rejected)
nodes.rationale: Rejected — the brand is cream/editorial; dark mode would double the token surface for no demo gain.

nodes.label: Phone Frame Mockup
nodes.rationale: Primary device is a ~390x844 phone frame on a warm neutral backdrop so it screen-mirrors cleanly on a projector. A pure native shell was rejected — a PWA in a phone frame is enough to demo and screen-mirror.

nodes.label: Trust Line
nodes.rationale: The line 'It proposes. You decide.' is always visible at a confirm step — reinforces the agent proposes but the user decides.

nodes.label: Typography Tokens
nodes.rationale: One typeface everywhere (Inter). The old Fraunces/Instrument Sans serif pairing was dropped — read as too 'editorial notebook' and not the crisp app feel wanted.

nodes.label: Activity Entity
nodes.rationale: Invalid if end <= start or day isn't in the seven-day set. Persists in localStorage.

nodes.label: Four-Beat Demo
nodes.rationale: scheduler → voice memo → WhatsApp listener → verdict. Must complete with taps only, no typing, no dead ends, in under 3 minutes.

nodes.label: localStorage Persistence
nodes.rationale: A backend database was rejected — single-device demo, localStorage is enough.

nodes.label: Notification Entity
nodes.rationale: Derived from a detected GroupMessage against the current week; 'busy' only if an existing Activity overlaps the proposed slot, otherwise 'free'. Session-ephemeral.

nodes.label: Verdict Entity
nodes.rationale: Resolves one Notification into a group post and, on accept/counter, one new/moved Activity. Verdict text is day-granularity only, never exact times (CONTEXT §6).

nodes.label: Local Whisper Sidecar
nodes.rationale: Local Python sidecar (whisper small.en via mlx-whisper/faster-whisper) at 127.0.0.1:8765, POST /transcribe. Runs local-only for security; scheduler must complete even if unreachable (fallback to a typed-memo path).

nodes.label: Two-Tab Navigation
nodes.rationale: Single-page app, no router — a demo doesn't need deep links or history (ponytail). Two tabs keyed by local state in App.tsx: week and voice. The in-app WhatsApp Chat tab was removed in favour of a real external bot.

nodes.label: LLM Agent
nodes.rationale: Understanding is an LLM call to an OpenAI-compatible gateway (VITE_LLM_BASE_URL default rootsys.cloud/v1). Falls back to an offline heuristic parser tagging proposals 'Offline parse' when no key is set, so the demo works without configuration.

nodes.label: Web Speech API Transcription
nodes.rationale: Transcription uses the browser's built-in Web Speech API — no Python sidecar and no key needed. Requires Chrome or Edge; falls back to a typed-memo input if the browser can't do it.

nodes.label: Scheduler Feature
nodes.rationale: Activities are keyed by weekday with no drag-to-edit and no month-spanning event model — added/removed through the form and confirm flows (ponytail: laziest model that works).

nodes.label: Module-Level Store Decision
nodes.rationale: useSyncExternalStore + a plain mutable module-level store, no Redux/Zustand — the laziest thing that survives reload via localStorage for a small demo.

nodes.label: Raw PCM Transcribe Contract
nodes.rationale: Raw int16 PCM over POST /transcribe, no multipart/wav — simplest contract; client decodes MediaRecorder webm to PCM and resamples to 16kHz via Web Audio AudioContext.

nodes.label: Python Sidecar STT Decision
nodes.rationale: STT in a Python sidecar, not in-browser whisper: transformers.js ports are slow/heavy (~1GB models, numpy). Reuses Zen's verified Jarvis pipeline. Note: this decisions doc predates the README's Web Speech API pivot.

nodes.label: Simulated WhatsApp Decision
nodes.rationale: The WhatsApp group is simulated via a 'Simulate incoming' button — live Baileys is against WhatsApp ToS and heavy for a POC; the wow is fully reproducible with one tap. Live Baileys/Cloud API noted as the production path.

nodes.label: Overlaid Toast Notification Decision
nodes.rationale: Notification as an overlaid toast inside the phone frame so the wow moment is visible over whatever screen the user is on; only the latest notification shows (queue's first item).

nodes.label: Free/Busy Colour Rule
nodes.rationale: Free/busy uses sage for clear and terracotta/amber for conflict — never red/green traffic-light harshness. Red/green rejected as too 'todo app'; sage + amber keeps the editorial feel.

nodes.label: Signature Move
nodes.rationale: Warm off-white + terracotta palette in clean Inter. Reads calm and modern; warmth comes from cream + terracotta, not a serif. Terracotta used sparingly — only the single primary action, today's date, and the conflict highlight — so every accent points at the one thing that matters.

nodes.label: Day-Granularity Verdict Rule
nodes.rationale: The group sees the verdict, not exact commitments (CONTEXT §6). verdictLine uses DAY_LABEL + time, never other activities — protects the user's private schedule.
